Engagement Associate Vice Provost Samba Dieng Associate Vice Provost, Office of Global Engagement As Associate Vice Provost, Samba Dieng heads the Office of Global Engagement and provides leadership and expertise on global engagement initiatives across the university. Originally from Senegal, Dieng came to the US as an undergraduate international student; this experience inspired his commitment to global education. He is active in organizations such the Institute of International Education (IIE), the Association of International Education Administrators (AIEA), the American Council on Education (ACE), and the Association of Public Land-Grant Universities (APLU). Dieng also sits on the board of the Association of International Educators (NAFSA) and on the IDP US Advisory Board. Prior to his role at LSU, Dieng served as Director of International Students and Scholars at several institutions. He holds a doctorate from the University of Texas at Austin, where he was named a Presidential Fellow. This is your invitation to dive into an extraordinary opportunity for growth, connection, and impact. Engaging in a faculty-led program shapes the future of our students while enriching your own professional and personal life. By leading a program, you’ll offer students immersive cultural experiences that deepen their understanding of the world, provide mentorship that fosters their growth, and open their eyes to new perspectives in your field. Through hands-on, experiential learning, you’ll not only enhance their education but also your own , as you engage in meaningful, transformative work that broadens both your and their horizons. Step up to lead a program and make an impact that lasts a lifetime. Help Students Geaux Global! As LSU faculty, you can offer students life-changing global experiences. Our Study Abroad team is here to help you get involved in international programs for LSU students. The resources below provide excellent starting points for your engagement with study abroad; you can learn about our current programs, collaborate with us to host a presentation for your students, or sign up for the Geaux Global Faculty Academy , our highly sought-after professional development series for faculty interested in designing new programs abroad. The Geaux Global Faculty Academy is designed to empower you to create transformative experiences for your students. As part of the Academy, you'll learn from experienced study-abroad faculty at LSU and from established best practices in the field. And when you complete the Academy, you'll earn a $2,000 grant to support your study abroad program. Apply Today Tools for Faculty Directors The following resources are for faculty who are currently directing a study abroad program or are working on a proposal for a new program. First-Time Proposals We’re excited that you’re interested in running a faculty-led program! Our Associate Director of Faculty Development collaborates with faculty across the university to develop programs and provide administrative and logistical support. To ensure study abroad opportunities are accessible to all LSU students, our goal is to have every school and major represented in our faculty-led programs. Fulbright programs are funded by the United States government and serve to advance global educational and cultural exchange through research, teaching, and professional projects.
